neighbours.label: The token 'breaking', strongest in 'X making and breaking' and in compounds such as 'backbreaking'. The pole is broad: other action verbs fire at about a third of this.
fire: The museum traces a century of rule making and breaking in sport.
Hauling stone up the hill was backbreaking labour.
The history of treaty making and breaking is long.
The guide covers lock making and breaking for beginners.
It was a heartbreaking end to the season.
Years of promise making and breaking had worn the voters out.
Farm life meant backbreaking days in the sun.
After weeks of jawbreaking toffee and backbreaking chores, he quit.
quiet: The museum traces a century of rule making and bending in sport.
Hauling stone up the hill was exhausting labour.
The history of treaty making and signing is long.
The guide covers lock making and fitting for beginners.
It was a heartwarming end to the season.
Years of promise making and forgetting had worn the voters out.
Farm life meant sweltering days in the sun.
After weeks of sticky toffee and endless chores, he quit.

notes: Card flags the pole broad (1.1% of tokens reach 0.1 of max; max only 0.94). Peaks: ' breaking' x3, 'breaking', '_break', 'broke', plus other verbs (fill, moving, read, remove). Probe: 'making and breaking' 0.73, 'backbreaking' 0.60, 'news is breaking' 0.29, ' break' 0.25, other verbs 0.21, 'openable' 0.34.
